metadata.description: Scout plugins by Yash Chowdhury: RecallScout, DepScout, GrantScout and FundScout India.

plugins.name: recallscout
plugins.description: Check US safety recalls for cars (by VIN or model), child car seats, consumer products and FDA-regulated food, with guided used-car and household recall checks.

plugins.name: depscout
plugins.description: Check npm, PyPI, Go, Maven, crates.io and NuGet packages for known vulnerabilities and malware, and audit a project's dependencies for safe upgrade targets.

plugins.name: grantscout
plugins.description: Search open and upcoming US federal grants on Grants.gov, match them to your organization and get eligibility, deadlines and how to apply.

plugins.name: fundscout
plugins.description: Live NAVs, returns, fund comparisons and exact SIP and lumpsum calculations for Indian mutual funds, with guided fund reviews. Factual data only, not investment advice.
